library: VSCO 2 Community Edition (VS Chamber Orchestra: CE)
author: Versilian Studios / Sam Gossner & Simon Dalzell; sample cutting by Elan Hickler (Soundemote)
selection: Trumpet, F horn and tenor trombone: sus and stac articulations, every velocity layer and round robin.
processing: Common leading silence trimmed (2 ms kept), sustains shortened to 4.5 s with an 80 ms fade, staccatos given a 15 ms tail fade, one fixed gain per instrument/articulation, stereo and sample rate kept, FLAC output.
pitch_convention: VSCO names middle C as C3; root_midi follows that (C3 = 60). tuning_cents is the measured autocorrelation pitch offset from the named note.
